# Common declaration/pattern first-source study

Eight complete original projects are preserved under `attempt-01/` before
checking. [Context](context.md) distinguishes informed authoring, current
grammar and parent-reported build provenance; [prerequisites](prerequisites.md)
state the existing exact-pattern/linear-owner requirements without predicting
a checker result.

Finite project checks and explicit selected-module checks remain separate.
`emit-proposal` produces untrusted bytes, not native acceptance. First
observations will be appended through the fixed authored driver, with actual
text/JSON diagnostics, native counts and CLI/source/stdlib/constitutional
identity. No execution, large input generation, production change or proof is
part of this record. The native logging launcher only delegates to the pinned
checker; it neither modifies checker semantics nor executes metadata commands.

The starting point does not complete common checking or any Issue. Keep this
source and all first diagnostics unchanged. Later repairs/replays need separate
records.
